tools.description: Returns the status and any results of a find_leads job, by jobId. tools.description: Lists the campaigns (past lead searches) in this workspace that the user takes part in, newest first. tools.description: Returns one campaign's ICP - the ideal-customer profile the agent derived and scores leads against - plus its outreach template and settings. The ICP comes back exactly as stored, in snake_case: `perfect_lead` and `reachable_market` are one-line summaries, while `company` and `person` hold the rules

tools.description: Sends an instruction to the agent inside an existing campaign and returns a jobId to read with fetch_leads. tools.name: list_pending_outreach
tools.description: Lists outreach messages the agent has drafted that are waiting for a human to approve - the 'a message for X is ready' queue. Each entry carries the draft text, the lead it is for, and why that lead scored as it did. Omitting campaignId covers the whole workspace. This tool sends nothing: rewrite_ou

tools.name: get_lead_memo
tools.description: Returns the research memo Onsa's agent wrote about one lead: role history, company size and stage, what they have said publicly, and the angle on them. It is usually far richer than scoreExplanation, and it is the source material for outreach built on a specific, checkable fact rather than a generic

tools.name: rewrite_outreach
tools.description: Replaces the text of an outreach draft that is waiting for approval. The current draft and the lead's scoreExplanation come from list_pending_outreach; get_lead_memo carries the richer research on that person. The rewritten draft stays in the approval queue, and this tool sends nothing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_leads, get_campaign, list_pending_outreach, list_replies, list_next_steps, get_campaign_stats · Private data: list_next_steps · Public sink: fetch_leads, list_campaigns, send_outreach, list_replies, get_campaign_stats · Destructive: continue_campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_leads, get_campaign, list_pending_outreach, list_replies, list_next_steps, get_campaign_stats · Private data: list_next_steps · Public sink: fetch_leads, list_campaigns, send_outreach, list_replies, get_campaign_stats · Destructive: continue_campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
